answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the onyx beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is published in the comet index and the vertex audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 67 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
